title: EE60027: Wind Energy
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Course Name: Wind Energy
Course No.: EE60027
L-T-P : 3-0-0
Prerequisite:EE21002,EE60035Module-1 (4 lectures): Introduction: past
developments and present trends; Construction and characteristics of high speed
wind turbines, Constant Speed Constant Frequency wind electrical systems,
Induction vs Synchronous generators.Module-2 (8 lectures): Aerodynamic
equations and characteristics of horizontal axis wind turbines, solidity, tip
speed ratio, torque and power coefficient, effect of wind shear and tower
shadow, Darrieus rotors and Savonious rotors; Module 3 (3 lectures): Drive
train components, wind turbine control systems; Module 4 (4 lectures): Wind
speed measurement and wind speed statistics, wind site analysis and selection,
capacity factor calculation.Module 5 (8 lectures): Grid connected and stand
alone Variable Speed Constant Frequency Generation using Squirrel cage
induction machines.Module 6 (8 lectures): Grid connected and stand alone
Variable Speed Constant Frequency Generation using Double output induction
machines. Module 7 (5 lectures): Grid connected and stand alone Variable Speed
Constant Frequency Generation using Permanent magnet synchronous machines.
